name: @royenheart/dsh-migrate-action
description: Composite GitHub Action that raises third-party DeepSeek Harness plugins to new harness releases and runs their checks; no model is consulted and no container is needed.

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node --test dist/tests/unit/*.test.js dist/tests/integration/*.test.js dist/tests/e2e/mechanical.test.js
